thread:
julie (Customer): Hi team — security wants assurance that during a 4-week eval all model inference, KV cache, and logs remain in the EU. They also asked for the most recent sub-processor roster and whether we support customer-controlled HSM keys for the POC. They want a price uplift if we lock the tenant to eu-west and remove automatic cross-region failover.

leo (Sales): @ravi @carmen tagging SE + Security. We can accommodate but with trade-offs. Quick Qs: do they need HSM for the POC or is cloud-KMS acceptable? Do they need dedicated GPUs or is a pinned hosted endpoint OK?

ravi (SE): Options: 1) Pinned hosted region (fastest), can restrict routing to eu-west and enable regional cache, but BYOK/HSM limited. 2) Dedicated reserved pool in eu-west — supports contractual key integration (requires onboarding). 3) Private (VPC) — full BYOK/HSM + no cross-region replication.
ravi (SE): Example routing config we'd apply for POC:

```
routing:
  policy: pinned
  region: eu-west-1
  failover: disabled
  cache: regional-only
  telemetry: route-tag=eu-poc
```

carmen (Security): We published subprocessors here: https://redwood.ai/legal/subprocessors (latest snapshot). For HSM: Private supports customer HSM today. Dedicated requires an onboarding ticket + key-access addendum. Logs: we can truncate or redact logs for POC and keep retention short.

julie (Customer): HSM preferred (YubiHSM). POC can accept contractual exception for catastrophic DR but must be pre-approved. Also please provide estimated delta on pricing for pinned-dedicated vs pinned-hosted.

leo (Sales): Ballpark pricing: pinned-hosted ~ baseline; pinned-dedicated adds ~40% due to capacity isolation; private is custom (license + infra). We can offer a 50% POC discount for 4 weeks if they commit to a 3-month follow-up evaluation. I'll get precise numbers after SE confirms expected qps.

ravi (SE): For verification, we can run egress traces. Use header `x-redwood-route: eu-only` and we'll log the path. Example curl: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "x-redwood-route: eu-only" \
  -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/chat
```
deploy-bot: route update applied -> tenant-pin-eu-2006112233, cache_scope=regional, failover=disabled

pat (Legal): I can draft a short addendum for the no-failover clause with an emergency exception that requires customer approval. Will need RTO/RPO targets and the list of SecOps contacts.

carmen (Security): BYOK onboarding doc: https://redwood.ai/support/byok-guide.pdf. For Dedicated HSM we require a one-time engineer window to configure key access and rotate policies. Also, please confirm whether they require audit logs to retain in-EU — we can set retention policy per tenant.

julie (Customer): Confirming: HSM required, retain security logs in EU for 90 days, DR only with explicit approval, expected qps ~40. Please cc secops@customerco.com.

leo (Sales): Action items: @ravi prepare detailed POC config + estimated infra cost for 40 qps, @carmen share subprocessors snapshot and BYOK timeline, @pat draft addendum. I'll schedule kickoff tomorrow 09:00 CET.

ravi (SE): Will send the POC plan + cost sheet by EOD. Plan includes smoke tests, latency benchmarking, KV trace, and security checklist.

julie (Customer): Thanks — looking forward to the invite.

leo (Sales): Invite sent.
